title: EAP based Identification initiation by the network

entities.name: EAP based Identification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network (AUSF, AAA server of CH or DCS) to perform EAP-based identification of the UE using EAP-Request/Identity or EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity messages.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message sent by AMF to UE that encapsulates EAP-Request/Identity or EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity messages for EAP-based identification.

entities.name: EAP-Request/Identity
entities.description: EAP message used for identity request in EAP-based identification procedure as specified in IETF RFC 5448.

entities.name: EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity
entities.description: EAP message used for AKA' identity request in EAP-based identification procedure as specified in IETF RFC 5448.

entities.name: AUSF
entities.description: Authentication Server Function that can initiate EAP-based identification procedure.

entities.name: AAA server of CH
entities.description: AAA server of Credentials Holder that can initiate EAP-based identification procedure.

entities.name: AAA server of DCS
entities.description: AAA server of De-Coupling Server that can initiate EAP-based identification procedure.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that encapsulates EAP messages in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST and sends to UE.

relations.description: EAP-based identification procedure can be initiated by AUSF.
EAP-based identification procedure can be initiated by AAA server of CH.
EAP-based identification procedure can be initiated by AAA server of DCS.
AMF sends AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to UE containing EAP messages.
